subcategory_text: Data elements can be accessed for review
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: SI-7 (Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity), AU-6 (Audit Review)
NIST PF 1.0 Core (January 2020): CT.DM-P1 (verified in NIST-Privacy-Framework-V1.0-Core.xlsx row 49)
GDPR Art. 15 (Right of access by the data subject)
Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 ID.AM-07 (data and metadata inventory)
implementation_examples: Provide authorised reviewers (internal compliance, DPO, data subject) with a documented access path to data elements held by the organisation
Maintain an index of data stores sufficient to locate data elements for review on request
Capture the provenance and processing history of data elements to support review
assessment_objectives: Determine whether data elements can be located and retrieved for review
Determine whether access paths exist for authorised internal and external reviewers
Determine whether retrieval is performed within documented timeframes
Determine whether data-provenance metadata is available to support review
